title: Error
description: On stdout: a failure, never a prompt, an answer, a stack or the token. A refusal to start (an unknown argument, a bad setting, an unreadable configuration file, a port it cannot listen on) exits 2; any other uncaught throw or rejection exits 1; a request handler's throw answers 500 and the bridge goes on. `host`, `port` and `code` are for a port it cannot listen on

kind.description: The program (or, for the bridge, the message type) that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation (for the bridge, per process), on every line it prints.

at.description: When the line was printed, UTC.

code.description: The system's error code, when listening failed (EADDRINUSE for a taken port).
